Powerful Blow.description: A committed strike that adds 5 damage to your attack.

Parry.description: Brace behind your weapon and reduce the next incoming attack by 5.

Magic Missile.description: Unerring arcane force deals 8 damage to your opponent, ignoring armor.

Mage Shield.description: A shimmering ward absorbs up to 6 damage.

Sneak Attack.description: Strike a weak point for double your normal damage.

Evade.description: Slip aside and avoid the next enemy attack entirely.

Cure Wounds.description: Channel divine power to recover 8 hit points.

Blessing.description: A brief blessing adds 2 to your next damage and wards off 2 damage from the next attack.

Fierce Attack.description: A powerful level-3 strike that adds 8 damage.

Multiattack.description: A level-5 flurry that deals double your normal damage.

Weapon Mastery.description: Level-7 mastery adds 3 damage and wards off 3 damage on the next exchange.

Fireball.description: A level-3 burst of flame deals 12 damage.

Teleport.description: A level-7 blink avoids the next enemy attack.

Backstab.description: A level-3 strike for triple your normal damage.

Evasion.description: Level-5 footwork reduces the next incoming attack by 8.

Poison Mastery.description: A level-7 venomous strike deals 9 damage.

Remove Curse.description: Level-3 divine light restores 5 hit points.

Divine Armor.description: Level-7 holy armor absorbs up to 10 damage.

Knock.description: Open a locked door or chest within two steps without needing its key.

Mage Hand.description: A spectral hand operates a door, chest or lever within two steps.

Guidance.description: Divine insight adds 2 to your next ability check.

Last Stand.description: A level-10 capstone: plant your feet and turn the next exchange in your favor. Adds 5 damage and prevents 5 damage.

Meteor Swarm.description: A level-10 capstone: call down a storm of falling stars for 30 damage that ignores armor.

Assassinate.description: A level-10 capstone: strike a lethal opening for four times your normal damage.

Divine Intervention.description: A level-10 capstone: a miracle of light restores 40 hit points.

Detect Magic.description: Sense magical auras nearby, revealing hidden magical traps and objects.

Disguise Self.description: Wear an illusory face and manner. Gain advantage on Stealth until you rest, and a one-use bluff in conversation.

Comprehend Languages.description: Read ancient script and inscriptions without a check.
